channel.title: Week 4 · Sensors, State Diagram, Sprint Review :: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: Today: your gadget gets senses (sensor) and a voice (actuator). You draw which states it can be in, and you show your progress at sprint review 1. What you will have at the end of the lesson Your board has a file hardware.py: everything that depends on the board is inside it. You have watched sensor values live in the plotter and chosen a threshold. Your team has a state diagram and a flowchart of the gadget. You demonstrated at the sprint review, got feedback and adjusted the backlog for sprint 2. 1. Stand-up (5 min) As always in front of the board. Additionally: What do we show at the review today? One person prepares the demo.
